We have released kew 4.4.2 and it's now packaged for several platforms.

Now with milkdrop visualizations, fuzzy search and lots of bug fixes.

We've never had as many developers continually helping out with this. We are currently focused on \"Project Joy\" where we want to fix every little annoying thing, glitch or bug, so that kew can truly be a \"joy to use\".

There are 10 000 visualizations presets included. This only works on Linux so far. Linux first!

https://kewplayer.com

#foss #opensource #music #linux #macos #windows #art

🚀 New #release · AiSOC v21.0.0

BREAKING
• Correlation grouping narrows on missing identifiers (the Changed
entry below). On upgrade, future alerts that carry no tactic group
per rule instead of per entity, and alerts with no identifiers at all
stop cross-rule merging entirely. Existing incidents are untouched;

Details, install & alternatives → https://selfhost.directory/project/aisoc?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social#update-24742518

Andon 2.0.0 is out 🎉

First release with a signed Windows installer: Windows now names the publisher, instead of "Unknown publisher". Thanks to Certum's open source code signing programme!

Andon is a free, local-first desktop app for tracking projects with signal colours. No account, your data stays on your computer. Windows and Linux.

https://andon.daelis.fr/
